# TalkOps DevOps Plugins

> Open-source DevOps and cloud engineering plugins for AI agents—bundling specialist agents, domain skills, MCP servers, and safety hooks for AWS, Kubernetes, and modern infrastructure operations across Claude Code, Codex, and any Agent Plugins 1.0.0 host.

This repository (`talkops-ai/devops-plugins`, marketplace ID `talkops-devops-plugins`, Apache-2.0) works across **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, and any host implementing the portable **Agent Plugins 1.0.0** specification (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Windsurf). Plugins are organized into three categories:

- **Agent plugins** (`plugins/agent-plugins/`): Self-contained AWS and Kubernetes specialist sub-agents (`agents/<name>.md` for Claude Code, `codex/agents/<name>.toml` for Codex) with scoped MCP servers, domain skills, slash commands, and guardrails.
- **Vertical plugins** (`plugins/vertical-plugins/`): Focused AWS domain bundles of skills, multi-phase slash-command playbooks, safety hooks, and MCP servers that attach directly to your main agent with no sub-agent hand-off.
- **Partner-built plugins** (`plugins/partner-built/`): Vendor and ecosystem plugins (HashiCorp Terraform, Crossplane AWS, LaunchDarkly, Coralogix, Honeycomb, Elastic, Neo4j, Bronto) shipping Claude Code, Portable Agent Plugins 1.0.0, and Codex layouts.

Install in Claude Code with `claude plugin marketplace add talkops-ai/devops-plugins` followed by `claude plugin install <plugin>@talkops-devops-plugins`, or in Codex with `codex plugin marketplace add talkops-ai/devops-plugins`. All plugins enforce a three-layer safety model: read-only MCP defaults, deterministic `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse` hooks (`secret-safety.py` across every plugin and `aws-mutation-gate.py` across AWS/IaC plugins), and least-privilege IAM guardrails.

## Core Documentation

- [Marketplace Overview](README.md): Complete plugin catalog, multi-host installation for Claude Code, Codex, and Agent Plugins 1.0.0, safety model, MCP binding architecture, and validation commands.
- [Agent Plugins Index](plugins/agent-plugins/README.md): Overview of specialist AWS and Kubernetes sub-agent plugins, slash commands, and MCP server bindings.
- [Vertical Plugins Index](plugins/vertical-plugins/README.md): Overview of main-agent AWS domain capability bundles and their mapping to counterpart specialist agent plugins.
- [Partner-Built Plugins Index](plugins/partner-built/README.md): Overview of third-party vendor and cloud-native ecosystem plugins, licenses, and MCP credentials.
- [Authoring Plugins Guide](docs/authoring-agent-plugins.md): Specification for creating and maintaining agent, vertical, and partner-built plugins, manifests, MCP bindings, connectors, and hooks.
- [MCP Server Coverage](docs/mcp-server-coverage.md): Matrix of bundled and optional connector MCP servers from `awslabs/mcp`, `talkops-ai/talkops-mcp`, and partner vendors.
- [IAM Guardrails](docs/iam-guardrails.md): Least-privilege IAM role patterns and AWS MCP condition keys backing read-only and approval-gated workflows.
- [Skill Evaluations Guide](evals/README.md): Open-source three-layer skill evaluation pipeline (`static`, `trigger`, `run`), directory layout, and open-source hygiene standards.

- [AWS AI and Machine Learning](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-ai-ml/README.md): Production Generative AI, Agentic AI, and ML engineering for the main agent: Amazon Bedrock (Converse API, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, LLM migration), Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Build, Connect, Deploy, Harden, Debug, Optimize, Pay) & Strands Agents, and Amazon SageMaker AI (Training, Inference, Fine-Tuning, MLOps Pipelines, Cost Estimation, Endpoint Diagnostics). (Commands: agentcore-deploy, bedrock-agent, genai-rag, migrate-llm-to-bedrock, sagemaker-endpoint-triage, sagemaker-job; MCP: agentcore, aws-mcp, awsiac, awsknowledge, awspricing, cloudwatch, sagemaker, strands-agents)
- [AWS Analytics](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-analytics/README.md): Modern data lakehouse and analytics engineering for the main agent: S3 Tables (Apache Iceberg), AWS Glue (Catalog, Spark ETL, Data Quality DQDL), Lake Formation governance, Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, Amazon OpenSearch, EMR, MWAA (Airflow), Kinesis/MSK streaming ingestion, and system-table auditing. (Commands: glue-data-quality, lake-formation-governance, lakehouse-design, opensearch-ops, redshift-optimize, spark-debug; MCP: aws-mcp, awsdataprocessing, awspricing, cloudwatch, redshift, s3tables, spark-troubleshooting)

- [AWS Quantum Computing](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-quantum-computing/README.md): Quantum computing and hybrid algorithm engineering on Amazon Braket for the main agent: OpenQASM 3.0 & Braket SDK circuit design, Managed Simulators (SV1, DM1, TN1), QPU hardware targeting (IonQ, Rigetti, IQM, QuEra), Braket Hybrid Jobs (VQE, QAOA, PennyLane adjoint differentiation), pre-execution shot/task cost governance, and VPC/KMS security. (Commands: debug-quantum-task, design-circuit, estimate-braket-cost, launch-hybrid-job; MCP: aws-mcp, awsknowledge, awspricing, cloudwatch)
- [AWS Resilience](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-resilience/README.md): Resilience engineering, disaster recovery, and chaos testing for the main agent: AWS Resilience Hub assessments, AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) chaos experiments with CloudWatch stop conditions, Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift/region switch, and multi-region RTO/RPO DR architecture. (Commands: assess-resilience, chaos-experiment, dr-strategy-matrix, game-day-runbook, zonal-shift; MCP: appsignals, aws-mcp, awsknowledge, awssupport, cloudtrail, cloudwatch)
- [AWS Security and Identity](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-security-identity/README.md): Cloud security, identity governance, and incident forensics for the main agent: IAM least-privilege & Access Analyzer, AWS Organizations SCPs/RCPs, KMS & Secrets Manager, Security Hub CSPM (OCSF), GuardDuty & CloudTrail incident triage, WAF/Network Firewall perimeter hardening, container workload security, and STRIDE threat modeling. (Commands: audit-iam, audit-kms-and-data-protection, rotate-secrets, security-posture, threat-model-stride, triage-guardduty-incident; MCP: aws-mcp, aws-security-agent, awsiac, cloudtrail, cloudwatch, iam, tm, wa-security)
- [AWS Serverless](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-serverless/README.md): Comprehensive serverless engineering skills for the main agent: AWS Lambda (SnapStart, Power Tuning, Durable Functions, Managed Instances), API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge (Buses, Scheduler, Pipes), SQS/SNS, Event Source Mappings, DynamoDB single-table modeling, Aurora DSQL, and SAM/CDK deployment. (Commands: api-gateway-design, configure-event-bus, debug-invocation, optimize-cold-starts, orchestrate-workflow, scaffold-function; MCP: aws-mcp, aws-serverless-mcp, awsknowledge, billing, cloudwatch, dynamodb, sns-sqs)
- [AWS Storage](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-storage/README.md): Cloud storage architecture, security, and operations for the main agent: Amazon S3 (Storage Lens, Intelligent-Tiering, Object Lock, S3 Tables), EFS performance & mount troubleshooting, EBS gp3/io2, FSx, AWS Backup vault lock, KMS data protection, and cross-region DR replication. (Commands: audit-s3-security, backup-and-replication-plan, optimize-storage-tiers, troubleshoot-efs; MCP: aws-mcp, awsiac, awspricing, cloudwatch, s3tables)
- [AWS Web and Mobile](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-web-and-mobile/README.md): Full-stack web, mobile, and geospatial engineering for the main agent: AWS Amplify Gen 2 (TypeScript-first Auth/Cognito, Data/AppSync GraphQL, Functions/CDK, Storage/S3, Hosting CI/CD, AI Kit), AWS Blocks, and Amazon Location Service V2 (Maps, Places, Routes, Trackers, Geofences). (Commands: amplify-gen2-deploy, amplify-init, configure-auth, graphql-api, location-maps-and-geofencing; MCP: appsync, aws-mcp, awsiac, awsknowledge, awslocation, cloudwatch, dynamodb)
- [AWS Well-Architected](plugins/vertical-plugins/aws-well-architected/README.md): Principal Solutions Architecture toolkit for the main agent: AWS Well-Architected Six-Pillar reviews, MADR 3.0 Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), Draw.io & Mermaid architecture diagrams, STRIDE threat modeling, multi-account Landing Zone design, and multi-region DR architecture. (Commands: architecture-diagram, generate-adr, landing-zone-design, review, threat-model; MCP: aws-mcp, awsiac, awsknowledge, awspricing, drawio, tm, wa-security)

## Partner-Built Plugins

- [Bronto Log Analytics](plugins/partner-built/bronto/README.md): Official Bronto dataset/collection discovery, SQL-style log search and time-series aggregation, and production error spike investigation skills with bundled remote MCP configuration (`BRONTO_API_KEY`, `BRONTO_REGION`). (Vendor: Bronto; License: Apache-2.0; Commands: discover-logs, investigate-spike, search-logs; MCP: bronto)
- [Coralogix](plugins/partner-built/coralogix/README.md): Official Coralogix DataPrime log/span analytics, PromQL metrics, alerts, cases, service catalog, RUM, AI Center, dashboards, Olly, and TCO data-usage skills with bundled remote MCP configuration (`CORALOGIX_API_KEY`, `CORALOGIX_REGION`). (Vendor: Coralogix; License: Apache-2.0; Commands: audit-tco, build-dashboard, query-dataprime, triage-incident; MCP: coralogix)
- [Crossplane AWS Platform Engineer](plugins/partner-built/crossplane-aws-engineer/README.md): Crossplane platform engineering skills for AWS: design XRDs, Pipeline Compositions, Claims, Upbound provider authentication, connection secrets, GitOps integration, and offline validation. (Vendor: TalkOps; License: Apache-2.0; MCP: aws-mcp, awsiac, awsknowledge)
- [Elastic Observability & Security](plugins/partner-built/elastic/README.md): Official Elastic SRE incident triage, service reliability, Kubernetes investigation, Cloud Security Posture (CSP), and LLM observability skills with bundled Elastic Agent Builder MCP configuration (`ELASTIC_PROJECT`, `ELASTIC_REGION`, `ELASTIC_API_KEY`). (Vendor: Elastic; License: Apache-2.0; Commands: audit-cloud-security, audit-llm-telemetry, investigate-k8s, triage-incident; MCP: elastic)
- [Honeycomb](plugins/partner-built/honeycomb/README.md): Official Honeycomb high-cardinality production investigation, wide-event/BubbleUp query patterns, OpenTelemetry metrics, SLO burn-rate & trigger triage, trace verification, and board creation skills with bundled remote MCP configuration (`HONEYCOMB_API_KEY`, `HONEYCOMB_MCP_URL`). (Vendor: Honeycomb.io; License: Apache-2.0; Commands: build-board, investigate-anomaly, triage-slo, verify-instrumentation; MCP: honeycomb)
- [LaunchDarkly](plugins/partner-built/launchdarkly/README.md): Official LaunchDarkly feature flag management, progressive guarded rollouts, experimentation, observability (logs, traces, errors, sessions), and AI Config / Agent Control graph skills with bundled remote MCP configuration (`LAUNCHDARKLY_ACCESS_TOKEN`). (Vendor: LaunchDarkly; License: Apache-2.0; Commands: audit-stale-flags, flag-rollout, investigate-errors, manage-ai-config; MCP: launchdarkly)
- [Neo4j Support Specialist](plugins/partner-built/neo4j/README.md): Official Neo4j 2026.x read-only diagnostics and `A1`–`A12` support runbooks for self-managed Neo4j on Amazon EKS, ECS, and EC2 with bundled Neo4j MCP configuration (`NEO4J_MCP_URL`, `NEO4J_MCP_AUTH`). (Vendor: Neo4j, Inc.; License: Apache-2.0; Commands: diagnose-cluster, triage-query; MCP: neo4j)
- [Terraform (HashiCorp)](plugins/partner-built/terraform/README.md): HashiCorp's official Terraform skills: HCL style, module refactoring, Terraform tests, search and bulk import, Stacks, Terraform policy (including Sentinel conversion), Azure Verified Modules, and provider development with the Plugin Framework (resources, actions, ephemeral resources, configuration, SDKv2 migration, docs, and acceptance tests). (Vendor: HashiCorp; License: MPL-2.0; MCP: aws-mcp, awsiac, awsknowledge, terraform)
